evidence.reason: The fixture creates real commits with Git but only sets user.name and user.email. It never disables inherited commit.gpgSign, so a developer or CI environment with global commit.gpgSign=true and no matching signing key for fixture@example.invalid will fail the first commit at line 94, erroring every DeployTests case in setUp(). Setting repository-local commit.gpgSign=false before that commit is the smallest compatible fix and does not change developer configuration.
